messages:
sasha: dropping notes from design slot — goal: a compact capacity editor for small screens and keyboard-first users. prototype: collapsible right rail simulator + compact steppers. https://figma.redwood/compact-capacity :eyes:
tom: love the compact idea. two quick asks: 1) make the simulator summary copyable for support, 2) show 'likely quota impact' with color + text (not color-only)
rebecca: wording nit: current label 'Max (autoscale)' confused a customer. suggest: 'Maximum autoscaled GPUs (incl. burst)'. explicit > ambiguous
lucy: accessibility: steppers need visible focus ring and tooltips that announce step increment. also add role=spinbutton for screen readers
ethan: on stepper behavior: propose micro-acceleration when holding arrow: 1x for 0-9, 5x for 10-49, 10x afterwards. keeps keyboard fast without surprise
sasha: for burst controls, swap 'duration' label to 'Burst window (mins)' + example placeholder 'e.g., +2 GPUs for 20 mins'
tom: small dev note — we should expose an event when simulator is collapsed/expanded so analytics can track discoverability: simulator_toggle
rebecca: UX: when preset applied, show a subtle in-context diff row summarizing changes (Min: 2 -> 6, Max: 8 -> 24, Burst: 0 -> 30). clickable to revert each change
lucy: keyboard flow: allow / to focus pool search, then type to filter; arrow keys between presets and pool list. announce preset name on apply via aria-live polite
ethan: backend example for simulator call (for infra team):
```
POST /api/v1/capacity/simulate
{ "pool": "eu-west-3-a100", "min": 6, "max": 24, "burst_minutes": 30 }
```
response: plain JSON with estimated_cost_delta, quota_status (ok/near/block), tail_95_ms
sasha: design asks: 1) show tiny cost delta next to presets, 2) add 'undo' snackbar for 8s after apply, 3) make pool badges text-first for contrast
tom: please also add a small 'request quota increase' quick action when quota_status != ok, opens modal pre-filled with current settings
rebecca: mobile behavior: simulator collapses to a 1-line summary row with chevron. tapping expands full panel. keep chevron target large for touch
lucy: accessibility follow-up: when simulator result changes, announce summary but avoid reading raw currency — prefer phrasing like 'estimated cost: small increase' if user prefers unitless
dev-bot: exported frames 1746005750-compact + 1746005800-mobile :white_check_mark: https://figma.redwood/compact-capacity/exports
sasha: we'll A/B test compact-default vs full-default to measure time-to-apply and support contacts. thanks all — i'll upload updated comps and copy later today :rocket:
